direction: An isometric 3D stack of dozens of creative cards receding into the distance, each a different brand colour, fanning out from a single source card. Depth via overlapping parallelograms and gradients. The one-becomes-thousands idea, rendered as illustration.
headline: One template. Endless variants.
subhead: Every card is the same build — only the data changed.

direction: A soft organic mesh / aurora poster: large blurred radial colour blobs in the brand palette bleeding into each other over the paper, with one enormous confident statement set over it. Generative, atmospheric — the opposite of a rigid grid.
headline: Zero marginal cost.
subhead: Image one and image ten thousand cost exactly the same: nothing.

direction: A faux terminal / build console window rendered as vector art: title bar with traffic-light dots, a monospace prompt running `adsmith render`, a streaming list of generated variant filenames with a progress bar, and a blinking cursor. Narrates the deterministic build as a scene.
headline: 10,000 variants, one command.
subhead: No API in the loop. Just a data sheet and a render step.
